title: JANUS DADDY_KEYMASTER: bounded Git-CAS queue, concurrent writers and live GitHub ref staging

implementation.description: Typed event-sourced queue on an isolated Git branch; commits use previously observed ref as single parent and nonforced fast-forward-only update; conflict is HOLD/re-fetch, not automatic retry.

cross_worker_jobs: Resume on a different ARM64 GitHub VM: SUCCESS
Fresh Linux witness (no write access): SUCCESS
github_ci.simulated_remote: Two separate temporary local Git clones sharing a bare Git remote. Competing processes race on the same head; exactly one non-forced fast-forward wins.
github_ci.proof_ceiling: Shows real Git ref arbitration in a test transport. Local bare remote is not a multi-host GitHub concurrency test.

real_github_remote_staging.independent_fetch_observation: Ref remained on alpha after failed sibling write; beta did not replace live state.
real_github_remote_staging.claim_limit: Does not establish precise stale failure classification or two independent GitHub-hosted writers racing the same remote branch.
